recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片幾乎被中到大型芽細胞鋪滿，核圓到卵圓、部分有凹陷或扭曲，染色質細緻、細胞質少且淡藍、無顆粒，正常造血細胞只剩零星嗜酸性球；型態像淋巴母細胞，需免疫表型確認 T 系。
features: Sheets of medium to large blasts replacing normal marrow elements
High N:C ratio with round to oval nuclei, some indented or convoluted
Finely dispersed chromatin with inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Scant to moderate pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Rare residual eosinophil and small mature lymphocytes; scattered fat vacuoles
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows near-total replacement by sheets of medium to large blasts, with only rare residual eosinophils and small lymphocytes. The blasts have a high N:C ratio, round to oval nuclei with occasional indentation or convolution, finely dispersed chromatin, inconspicuous nucleoli and scant pale blue agranular cytoplasm. No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules are identified. Morphology is consistent with lymphoblastic leukemia; flow cytometry supports T-lymphoblastic leukemia.

ddx.vs: B- and T-lymphoblasts are morphologically indistinguishable; CD19/CD79a versus cytoplasmic CD3 by flow cytometry separates them.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: AML-M0 blasts may look identical but are MPO-negative on cytochemistry and express CD13/CD33/CD117 without cCD3.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with prominent lipid vacuoles and a mature B phenotype (sIg+, TdT-), unlike these pale agranular blasts.
